en: Ah! Here is a peerless knight.
zh: 啊！真是一位举世无双的骑士。

en: (A shame he wants to kill us.)
zh: （可惜他想杀我们。）

en: Hi， um， I'm Nicole!
zh: 你好，那个，我叫妮可！

en: Let's be friends? No?
zh: 我们做朋友吧？不行吗？

en: Hm? What now?
zh: 嗯？又怎么了？

en: This sword...
zh: 这把剑……

en: You want me to have it? All right...
zh: 你想把它交给我？好吧……

en: Feels... incredible. Full of fury， and power!
zh: 这感觉……难以置信。充满了愤怒与力量！

en: It's like... he's speaking to me through the sword--telling me everything he went through.
zh: 就像……他正透过这把剑对我说话，诉说自己经历的一切。

en: Well， don't worry， friend. I'll finish what you started!
zh: 别担心，朋友。你的未竟之志，我来完成！

en: Rest in peace， valiant knight of the true crown.
zh: 安息吧，忠于真正王室的英勇骑士。

en: I wish we had not come to blows. But I swear to strike down the source of our pain!
zh: 真希望我们不曾兵刃相向。但我发誓，必将斩断这苦痛的根源！

en: It must take some SERIOUS hard feelings to un-die.
zh: 得是多大的怨气，才能死了又爬起来啊。

en: I hope he rests easier knowing we've taken up his torch.
zh: 我们接过了他的遗志，但愿他能安息。

en: Your soul is at war， even in death. You feel betrayed.
zh: 哪怕身死，你的灵魂仍在交战。你感到自己被背叛了。

en: I understand.
zh: 我明白。

en: The voices have gone silent.
zh: 那些声音沉寂了。

en: I hope they're at peace.
zh: 愿他们安息。

en: I have become aware that a bit of the old royal bloodline has dripped into the present.
zh: 我发现，旧王族的一丝血脉竟然流传到了如今。

en: A woman: one who could have been a great knight， but has chosen instead to sow disorder in the kingdom's finest moment.
zh: 是个女人。本可以成为伟大的骑士，却偏偏要在王国最辉煌的时刻兴风作浪。

en: Why， Serena? Your family died generations ago and the world moved on.
zh: 为什么呢，瑟蕾娜？你的家族早在几代前就死绝了，世人也早已忘却。

en: Hold your tongue， snake!
zh: 闭嘴，毒蛇！

en: The world never moved on. You dragged it off its wheels!
zh: 世人从未忘却。是你把世界拖入了深渊！

en: My kin died so the magic of a dark wizard could mock the true glory of the throne!
zh: 我的族人被杀，只为让一个黑魔法师的妖术践踏王室真正的荣耀！

en: You do have spirit. I can see a bit of the old queen's fire in you.
zh: 你倒是很有骨气。我能从你身上看见旧王后当年的几分烈性。

en: That look of defiance was the last expression she wore， my little princess.
zh: 小公主，你这不屈的眼神，也是她临死前最后的表情。

en: P-Princess!?
zh: 公、公主！？

en: Serena's... a princess? (So much for asking her out.)
zh: 瑟蕾娜……是公主？（这下没戏约她出去了。）

en: Ah! I might have known! Her patriotic spirit， her clarity of mind--these are royal traits!
zh: 啊！我早该看出来！她的爱国之心，她的清明睿智……这都是王者风范！

en: Sometimes it feels like everyone's a princess but me.
zh: 有时候真觉得，除了我，人人都是公主。

en: No! You're lying! My family has ruled this land since ancient times!
zh: 不！你在撒谎！我的家族自古便统治着这片土地！

en: Father would have spoken of it， were House Valgar not the first to sit the throne!
zh: 如果瓦尔加家族不是最早登上王座的，父王一定会告诉我！

en: Ha ha ha ha! I remember a warrior... He fought to his last breath the night your family was destroyed. Scores of my men died on his blade before he expired on the outskirts of town.
zh: 哈哈哈哈！我还记得一个战士……你家族覆灭的那夜，他奋战至最后一息。我的士兵数十人死于他剑下，他最后也倒在了城外。

en: How very fitting that he should lead the last of you to me today!
zh: 如今竟由他将你们家族最后的血脉带到我面前，真是再合适不过了！

en: I see. Then he is more than just some hero whose bones washed white with history.
zh: 原来如此。那么，他不只是某个早已被历史遗忘的英雄。

en: He was a brave man who tried to protect my family.
zh: 他是一位曾为保护我家族而战的勇士。

en: The old king said before he died--
zh: 老国王临死前说过——

en: “Mine is a kingdom of swords.  These crimes， too， shall be  avenged by the sword.“
zh: “吾之王国，乃剑之王国。这等罪行，也必将由剑来讨还。”

en: As a precaution， I ordered my soldiers to gather every scrap of steel and iron.
zh: 以防万一，我命令士兵搜遍了所有的钢铁兵刃。

en: Not one sword in the realm had such power. But it appears I gave up too quickly.
zh: 全国竟没有一把剑拥有那种力量。看来是我放弃得太早。

en: The most powerful weapon in existence， unearthed by a ragtag band of nobodies! Ha! Had they and the sword found me instead of you， all of us would have been spared so much misery.
zh: 世上最强大的武器，居然让一群乌合之众挖了出来！哈！他们要是带着剑来投奔我，而不是你，大家都能少受多少苦啊。

en: Explain yourself， Kanon. You already wielded absolute power in all but name.
zh: 把话说清楚，卡农。你早就有了至高无上的权力，只差一个名号。

en: What's so important that you had to destroy my family!?
zh: 到底有什么事，值得你灭我全族！？

en: Did you know our world was once home to three races?
zh: 你们可知道，这个世界曾有三个种族？

en: Heaven and earth were ruled by two warring tribes called the Skyborn and the Earthblood.
zh: 统治天空与大地的，是两个相互征战的种族：天界人与地界人。

en: As they fought viciously to eradicate each other，
zh: 他们为将对方斩尽杀绝而激烈厮杀时，

en: the third race--our race-- could only cower in fear.
zh: 第三个种族，也就是我们，只能在恐惧中瑟缩。

en: But that changed when the Skyborn gave humans a gift: power to see nature's workings.
zh: 但天界人送给人类一件礼物，改变了这一切：洞悉自然法则的力量。

en: So grateful were we for this “majestic logic，“ or “magic，“ we chose to help the Skyborn.
zh: 我们对这套“玄妙之理”，也就是“魔法”，感激不尽，于是选择帮助天界人。

en: We battled the Earthblood at the cost of many human lives.
zh: 我们与地界人作战，为此牺牲了无数人类。

en: In the end， we did what the Skyborn never could， and cast the Earthblood into darkness.
zh: 最终，我们做到了天界人未能做到的事，将地界人逐入黑暗。

en: But did the Skyborn thank us? Ha!
zh: 可天界人感谢我们了吗？哈！

en: Oh， how the jealous fiends thanked us.
zh: 那些嫉妒成性的恶鬼，真是好一番“感谢”！

en: Fearful of our god-like power， they cast us into the same dark prison as the Earthblood. We who gave our lives for them!
zh: 他们惧怕我们比肩神明的力量，将我们与地界人一起关进了黑暗牢狱！我们可是曾为他们舍命的人啊！

en: Only the magically uninclined were spared， sparking a dreary epoch called the Age of Swords.
zh: 只有不通魔法的人得以幸免，于是，枯燥的“剑之时代”开始了。

en: I waited an eternity for the moment I could escape my prison and restore magic to a world that sorely lacked it.
zh: 我等待了无尽的岁月，只为逃出牢狱，将魔法带回这个失去它的世界。

en: I subjugated the Earthblood's leader， and， in time， clawed my way back to freedom.
zh: 我降服了地界人的首领，历经漫长岁月，终于重获自由。

en: But when I told the royal family of the great power men had lost， they scoffed! The ungrateful fools deserved to be killed and replaced.
zh: 可我告诉王室，人类曾失去多么伟大的力量时，他们竟嗤之以鼻！这群忘恩负义的蠢货，活该被杀，活该被取代。

en: Replaced with us? My family are puppets for some VENDETTA?
zh: 被我们取代？我的家族只是你用来复仇的傀儡？

en: Vendetta? Don't be petty. Humanity wants and needs this!
zh: 复仇？别想得这么狭隘。人类渴望它，也需要它！

en: I warned you against choosing swords over sorcery， young Valgar. The king， at least， knows better than to try and pull his own strings.
zh: 年轻的瓦尔加，我早就告诫过你，不要弃魔法而选刀剑。至少国王懂得，傀儡就不该妄图自己拉线。

en: Father is colluding with you? No... he would never...
zh: 父王在与你串通？不……他绝不会……

en: My business now is with the band who found the sword.
zh: 现在，我要和找到宝剑的几位谈谈。

en: That woman has led you astray and put your lives in danger.
zh: 那个女人误导了你们，害你们身陷险境。

en: Soon a world balanced by magic will be upon us. Why not think about your fellow man， and fight on behalf of the future we all deserve， hmm?
zh: 以魔法维系平衡的世界即将到来。何不为人类同胞想想，为我们应得的未来而战，嗯？

en: No. I'm a visionary!
zh: 不，我是远见卓识之人！

en: The world will spin the way I want it to spin. With magic，  humanity will become the strongest race of all!
zh: 世界将遵我的意愿运转。有了魔法，人类将成为最强大的种族！

en: Nngh!? Impossible! Nothing can break that spell! What ARE you?
zh: 呃！？不可能！没有什么能破除那个咒术！你到底是什么？

en: I shall pick you apart until I find my answer!
zh: 我非把你拆个彻底，查出答案不可！

en: Fools! You will regret... siding with the Skyborn...
zh: 蠢货！站在天界人那边……你们会后悔的……

en: Ye who see magic's evils for what they are--come to me.
zh: 看清魔法罪恶本质之人啊……到我这里来。

en: Enter my realm without fear， for I have been waiting.
zh: 不必畏惧，进入我的领域吧。我已等候多时。

en: The old monarchy forced my hand. They simply could not be brought to see the truth.
zh: 是旧王室逼我动手的。他们根本不愿认清真相。

en: Nngh!? Impossible! Nothing can break that spell! Such incredible power...
zh: 呃！？不可能！没有什么能破除那个咒术！如此惊人的力量……

en: But you mistake me for a mage. I AM A MASTER!
zh: 但别把我当成普通法师。我可是大魔导师！

en: Word of your exploits has spread quickly， warriors.
zh: 战士们，你们的事迹已传遍各地。

en: Our own attempts to stand up to Kanon cost us our village and families. But today... You gave us vengeance and victory in one great stroke!
zh: 我们曾试图反抗卡农，却赔上了村庄和家人。可今天……你们一举为我们报了仇，赢得了胜利！

en: Bah! As long as the Skyborn rule on high， we will never have peace! The Earthblood answer to me now. With their power， I can finally set this world right!
zh: 呸！只要天界人仍高居云端，我们就永无宁日！地界人如今听我号令。有他们的力量，我终于能让世界回归正轨！

en: You will regret being reborn into this world， fool! All of you will!
zh: 蠢货，你会后悔重返人世！你们所有人都会后悔！

en: What have you done? This world will crumble without me! The Skyborn and Earthblood... will tear it apart...
zh: 你们干了什么？没有我，这个世界会崩溃！天界人和地界人……会把它撕成碎片……

en: Force brought me the power of the Earthblood， and force gave humanity back the power your forefathers died for!
zh: 我用武力夺得地界人的力量，也用武力，为人类夺回你们先祖为之献身的力量！

en: Now， force will tear the proud Skyborn out of the heavens!
zh: 现在，我要用武力，把高傲的天界人从天上拖下来！

en: Nngh!? Impossible! Nothing can break that spell! We shall settle this later.
zh: 呃！？不可能！没有什么能破除那个咒术！这笔账，稍后再算。

en: If you spoke truly， then these other races may be a threat.
zh: 若你所言属实，另外两个种族或许确是威胁。

en: But that does not absolve you.
zh: 但这并不能洗清你的罪孽。

en: It ends now. By the sword!
zh: 一切就此了结。以剑为断！

en: Ah， but you have just sealed your own fate. The Skyborn are watching!
zh: 啊，可你们刚刚亲手断送了自己的命。天界人正看着呢！

en: You know the truth--and more damning still， they have seen that you believe me! You have already been judged.
zh: 你们知道了真相……更致命的是，他们看出你们相信我！你们的判决已经定下。

en: Warriors! Do not be afraid. I wish you no harm.
zh: 战士们，不要害怕。我无意伤害你们。

en: There is a matter we must discuss. You wish to face Kanon? I can arrange for that... briefly.
zh: 有一件事必须与你们商谈。你们想面对卡农？我可以安排……片刻。

en: I must have a way with monsters.
zh: 看来我还挺会对付怪物。

en: But it is time you and I severed our ties once and for all!
zh: 但你我之间的纠葛，也该彻底了断了！

en: WHY!? Why can I not kill you? It's that accursed sword. What secret does it hold?
zh: 为什么！？为什么我杀不死你？是那把该死的剑。它到底藏着什么秘密？

en: Graaah! Now even mortal men are walking around with these monsters' blades!
zh: 可恶！如今连凡人都带着这些怪物的剑，招摇过市了！

en: What secrets do the accursed things hold?
zh: 这些该死的东西究竟藏着什么秘密？

en: You haven't seen one because they come from a better time!
zh: 你没见过，是因为它们来自一个更好的时代！

en: Before your magic polluted the world， there was an Age of Swords. Blades like this belonged to knights who served the true king--died protecting him from pretenders like your father!
zh: 在你的魔法污染世界之前，曾有一个剑之时代。这样的剑，属于侍奉真正国王的骑士……他们为保护国王，死于你父亲这样的篡位者之手！

en: What jape is this? True king? Pretenders?
zh: 开什么玩笑？真正的国王？篡位者？

en: Your mind's as far gone as these skeletons'. Shall I put you to rest by their side?
zh: 你的脑子也跟这些骷髅一样腐朽了。要我送你去陪他们长眠吗？

en: Would that you could， my prince. But it seems more direct intervention is required.
zh: 王子殿下，真希望你办得到。但看来，我必须亲自插手了。

en: Still alive?
zh: 还活着？

en: Our knights are getting soft.
zh: 我们的骑士真是越来越不中用了。

en: Compared to the ones who served the true monarchy， your men are like babes in armor.
zh: 比起侍奉真正王室的骑士，你的人不过是穿着铠甲的婴儿。

en: Maybe you need a true crown to serve to show your potential.
zh: 也许得侍奉真正的王室，你才能发挥潜力。

en: You need a real king to make a real knight， buddy.
zh: 伙计，得有真国王，才有真骑士。

en: Ha! One impostor breeds another.
zh: 哈！冒牌货只会养出冒牌货。

en: Yeah， well， if they were the REAL royal knights， we would have got our butts handed to us!
zh: 是啊，要他们是真正的王国骑士，我们早就被揍趴下了！

en: What are you implying?
zh: 你们在暗示什么？

en: I've had more of this farce than I can stomach. En garde!
zh: 这场闹剧我已忍无可忍。拔剑吧！

en: It's a bird! It's a plane!
zh: 是鸟！是飞机！

en: Nope， it's our sexy frames! Who takes from the flabby and gives to the stacked? Just us， baby: the Glutes are back!
zh: 错啦，是我们性感的身躯！谁专抢肥肉、接济肌肉？就是我们！翘臀团回来啦！

en: Whoopsy-daisy. Who do you think owns this wasteland?
zh: 哎呀呀。知道这片荒地归谁管吗？

en: Time to pay up in gold!
zh: 该拿金子来交路费了！

en: Or... I guess we accept golden warriors. Wait'll the boss gets a load of him!
zh: 或者……金灿灿的战士也行。老大见了他准乐坏！

en: What， you guys again? Ugh， you know the drill. Buns in gear， brigands! Take 'em to the boss.
zh: 什么，又是你们？唉，规矩都懂。强盗们，翘臀动起来！带他们去见老大。

en: Ha! Well met， trespassers.
zh: 哈！幸会啊，闯入者。

en: Macho applauds your gumption as only Macho can.
zh: 马乔要用马乔独有的方式，赞赏你们的胆量。

en: Have you come bearing gifts?
zh: 带礼物来了吗？

en: That golden warrior will do.
zh: 那个金灿灿的战士就不错。

en: You still owe Macho a golden warrior. Once he joins the Glutes， his well-textured armor will be oiled daily!
zh: 你们还欠马乔一个金灿灿的战士。他若加入翘臀团，那身精致的铠甲，每天都能抹油保养！

en: Ugh. Put a shirt on， knave!
zh: 恶心。把衣服穿上，贱民！

en: Ha! You take YOUR shirt OFF， weakling!
zh: 哈！你才该脱掉衣服呢，弱鸡！

en: Those are some sweet biceps for a prince whose family likes magic more than muscle! How much do those blades weigh?
zh: 王子一家明明更爱魔法、不爱肌肉，二头肌倒练得不错！你那对剑有多重？

en: Er... Macho. May I ask you a question?
zh: 呃……马乔。我能问你件事吗？

en: Where did you get the sword in that box?
zh: 箱子里的剑，你是从哪里弄来的？

en: Ah! You like Macho's beefy sword?
zh: 啊！看上马乔这把雄壮宝剑了？

en: This was our prize from robbing a royal storehouse. Why a bunch of wizard wimps would want it eludes Macho.
zh: 这是我们抢劫王室仓库的战利品。那些软弱的魔法师留着它做什么，马乔可想不通。

en: Want it? Our knights would never bother with a vulgar scrap of metal like that.
zh: 留着它？我们的骑士才不会稀罕这么块粗俗的废铁。

en: Correct. Yours would not.
zh: 不错，你们的骑士不会。

en: This is from the Age of Swords， when the true monarchy wielded it against traitors like Kanon... and you!
zh: 这把剑来自剑之时代。当年真正的王室，就是用它对抗卡农……以及你这样的叛徒！

en: More implications. What is this about?
zh: 又在含沙射影。到底什么意思？

en: What? Will you not cease these childish stories?
zh: 什么？你们还要继续讲这些幼稚故事吗？

en: Ugh， it reeks of butt-sweat in here. I need some air.
zh: 呕，这里满是屁股汗味。我得出去透口气。

en: Hmph. You low-life thieves can count yourselves lucky. Next time I see you is the day I cut you down!
zh: 哼，你们这些下贱盗贼，算你们走运。下次见面，就是你们的死期！

en: Macho senses inner conflict...
zh: 马乔感受到了内心的矛盾……

en: In him， but also in you. You are taking on the crown?
zh: 他有，你们也有。你们要对抗王室？

en: Then go! Bring tone back to this dark and flabby world!
zh: 那就去吧！让这个黑暗松垮的世界，重新绷紧肌肉！

en: You rogues have kept too many secrets from me. What is it you think you know!?
zh: 你们这些恶徒瞒了我太多。你们到底知道些什么！？

en: I will tell you!
zh: 我来告诉你！

en: Enemies of the crown! You have taken your last step.
zh: 王室的敌人！你们到此为止了。

en: I cannot allow you to push my kingdom toward destruction!
zh: 我绝不容许你们将我的王国推向毁灭！

en: Why， Valgar?
zh: 为什么，瓦尔加？

en: Because you and your father would rather do it yourself?
zh: 因为你和你父亲想亲自动手？

en: Yeah， that's your job， right? How's it feel to choke people with magic WE DON'T WANT!?
zh: 是啊，那不是你们的活儿吗？拿我们根本不想要的魔法勒住百姓的脖子，感觉如何！？

en: Us? You're the ones taking magic and twisting it! Magic is about free choice!
zh: 我们？滥用、扭曲魔法的明明是你们！魔法本该让人自由选择！

en: Yes， I see the destruction you speak of--and before me， the destroyer!
zh: 不错，我看见了你所说的毁灭……也看见了眼前的毁灭者！

en: I'll push as many kingdoms toward destruction as I want! Wait， that came out wrong.
zh: 我想毁几个王国就毁几个！等等，这话好像不对。

en: Shut up!
zh: 闭嘴！

en: Well， you have improved a bit， I see.
zh: 看来，你们确实进步了一点。

en: Let's take this outside， where there's room to beat on you!
zh: 去外面打，才有地方好好收拾你们！

en: The world will spin the way I want it to spin. With magic，   humanity will become the strongest race of all!
zh: 世界将遵我的意愿运转。有了魔法，人类将成为最强大的种族！

en: Now， where were we?
zh: 刚才说到哪儿了？

en: You... nngh， DARE!
zh: 你……呃，竟敢！

en: Hee hee hee! Why good morning， good knight! (See what I did there?)
zh: 嘻嘻嘻！早上好呀，好骑士！还没跟你道晚安呢！

en: Zur? Get your buffoons out of the way!
zh: 祖尔？让你的那群蠢货让路！

en: My goodness! Who tinkled in your spaulders?
zh: 哎呀！谁往你的肩甲里撒尿了，这么大火气？

en: I have business with you.
zh: 我找你有事。

en: What are you-- What “business“?
zh: 你在……什么“事”？

en: Oh， how about your arrest and/or execution? What were Lord Kanon's exact words? Ah yes. “The fool would rather die than know the truth.“
zh: 比如，逮捕你，或者处决你？卡农大人原话怎么说来着？啊，对了。“那蠢货宁死也不肯认清真相。”

en: Isn't he thoughtful? You must be so pooped from pretending to be a prince all the time!
zh: 他多体贴啊！你成天装王子，一定累坏了吧！

en: Something else has come up. I will deal with you later!
zh: 眼下有别的事。回头再收拾你！

en: Where is Kanon?
zh: 卡农在哪儿？

en: Take me to him. Now!
zh: 带我去见他。马上！

en: B-But I'm just the messenger!
zh: 可、可我只是个传话的！

en: I don't care who's real and who's a fraud! I stick with the winners! See? We're tight!
zh: 我才不管谁真谁假！我只跟赢家站一边！看见没？我们关系铁着呢！

en: Correct! Power is Justice.   And justice calls for great power!
zh: 正确！力量即正义。而正义，需要强大的力量！

en: Now what kind of reckless  fools would pick a fight with the Blue Order?
zh: 究竟是怎样不知死活的蠢货，敢找蓝之骑士团的麻烦？

en: Gash? What are you doing here?
zh: 加修？你怎么会在这里？

en: Urp!
zh: 呃！

en: Uh... ohhhhh.
zh: 呃……糟喽。

en: Hiya， Captain.
zh: 嗨，团长。

en: Fancy meeting you here.
zh: 真巧，在这儿碰到你。

en: Ick! So much for safety in the woods.
zh: 讨厌！还以为树林里会安全呢。

en: An unfortunate encounter.
zh: 真是冤家路窄。

en: But now that we know the truth about the crown， this is a battle we must fight!
zh: 不过，既然已知王室的真相，这一战就避无可避！

en: Oh， sweet!
zh: 哦，太好了！

en: I'm dressed to match!
zh: 我这身打扮正好配你们！

en: Oh， so you're the bunch causing all the ruckus.
zh: 哦，原来闹出这么大动静的就是你们。

en: Serena， is that you?
zh: 瑟蕾娜，是你吗？

en: So you're one of the rebels holding His Majesty's feet to the fire? Hmm， can't solve this one with practice swords.
zh: 你也成了让陛下焦头烂额的叛党？嗯，这回可不能拿练习剑解决了。

en: Han， is that you?
zh: 哈恩，是你吗？

en: Huh. Ya mean you're one of the rebels holding His Majesty's feet to the fire? Guess it's time for another contest.
zh: 呵，你也成了让陛下焦头烂额的叛党？看来得再比一场了。

en: All right， you blue dogs! Go find the princess! I'll be done here in a second.
zh: 好了，你们这些蓝皮狗！去找公主！我马上就能收拾完这里。

en: The princess? She's run away again?
zh: 公主？她又跑出来了？

en: Princess... Lucia's here!?
zh: 公主……露西亚在这里！？

en: Guess I need work.
zh: 看来还得练啊。

en: That Serena... Nngh! She fights like a dragon.
zh: 瑟蕾娜那家伙……唔！凶得像条龙。

en: Well fought， Han...
zh: 打得好，哈恩……

en: A fearful monster... Wrong color armor， though.
zh: 真是可怕的怪物……可惜铠甲颜色不对。

en: Idiots! Don't worry about me! Do your job!
zh: 笨蛋！别管我！去办你们的正事！

en: Fools! Arrgh... You have a job to do!
zh: 蠢货！呃啊……你们还有任务！

en: Hey!  My gang is mid-klepto， and you're muscling in on our prospecto.
zh: 喂！我们正在行窃，你们却来抢这门生意。

en: I was right. Princess Lucia...
zh: 我猜得没错。露西亚公主……

en: No wonder Gash came in person.
zh: 难怪加修会亲自过来。

en: Huh? That's Lucia!
zh: 咦？那是露西亚！

en: The captain said she'd run away again...
zh: 团长说她又溜出来了……

en: We Glutes know the scuttlebutt! Miss Princess here ditches the castle a lot. Guess she loves breakin' the rules! Just one prob--she ain't got no jewels.
zh: 我们翘臀团消息灵通！这位公主小姐三天两头溜出城堡。看来就是爱违抗规矩！可惜就一点不好——身上一颗宝石都没有。

en: Han? Why are you here? It's not... true， is it?
zh: 哈恩？你为什么在这里？难道……那些都是真的？

en: Lucia! Where are you? Why can't you just stay put!?
zh: 露西亚！你在哪儿？就不能安分待着吗！？

en: Uh-oh. Another rowdy baddy! C'mon， boys--let's skedaddy!
zh: 哎哟，又来了个凶神恶煞！兄弟们，快跑吧！

en: You!
zh: 是你！

en: Don't， Brother. These warriors just saved me from bandits.
zh: 别动手，哥哥。是这些战士从强盗手中救了我。

en: Besides， you need to know why I left the castle this time.
zh: 而且，你得知道我这次为什么离开城堡。

en: It wasn't out of curiosity!
zh: 这次不是因为好奇！

en: Why， then?
zh: 那是为什么？

en: There is no excuse for disrupting life at the castle for these excursions!
zh: 无论如何，也不能为了你私自出游，就搅得城堡不得安宁！

en: Yes there is. I found out something I shouldn't have.
zh: 这次可以。我发现了不该知道的事。

en: I overheard a conversation between Kanon and a horrible monster. It was terrifying!
zh: 我偷听到卡农跟一个可怕怪物的谈话。吓死人了！

en: I know why they want to force magic on the world... and who you and I really are.
zh: 我知道他们为什么要逼全世界接受魔法……也知道你我真正的身份了。

en: It is not polite to eavesdrop， Princess. I must punish you.
zh: 偷听可不礼貌，公主。我得惩罚你。

en: Lucia， find someplace to hide.
zh: 露西亚，找地方躲起来。

en: Not the castle--it isn't safe.
zh: 别回城堡，那里不安全。

en: But Brother...
zh: 可是，哥哥……

en: Go. Now!
zh: 走！马上！

en: Nice， let me shake your... Wait， which piece is your hand?
zh: 不错，握个手吧……等等，你的手是哪一块？

en: You slippery rogues.
zh: 你们这些滑头恶徒。

en: Luck cannot save you now!
zh: 这次运气可救不了你们！

en: Don't!
zh: 住手！

en: Lucia! Why are you here?
zh: 露西亚！你怎么在这里？

en: This is a battlefield! Get back inside the castle!
zh: 这里是战场！快回城堡里去！

en: Lucia?
zh: 露西亚？

en: Stop this， Brother. Our family is bringing ruin to the kingdom!
zh: 别打了，哥哥。我们的家族正在把王国推向毁灭！

en: Don't be dramatic， Princess. The people may be slow to adopt magic at the scale I-- we desire， but such is progress.
zh: 公主，别说得这么夸张。百姓接受魔法的速度，也许跟不上我……我们期望的规模，但进步总是如此。

en: No one “adopts“ anything!
zh: 谁也没有“接受”任何东西！

en: You give them no choice， just as you give my family no choices. I know the truth!
zh: 你根本没给他们选择，就像没给我们家族选择一样。我知道真相了！

en: Then I suggest you WATCH YOUR TONE.
zh: 那我劝你注意语气。

en: You're not royalty. You are a figurehead， one I can cut off and replace as I see fit!
zh: 你不是什么王族。你只是我摆在台上的人偶，想砍掉换一个，随时都可以！

en: Lucia， leave here at once.
zh: 露西亚，立刻离开这里。

en: Kanon has lost his mind!
zh: 卡农已经疯了！

en: No! I will not leave until he is punished!
zh: 不！不惩罚他，我就不走！

en: I said go， Lucia! Now!
zh: 我叫你走，露西亚！马上！

en: Be at peace， humans.
zh: 人类，安心吧。

en: You stand in the Skyborn's heavenly realm， far above the earth.
zh: 你们如今身处远离大地的高空，天界人的圣域。

en: I summoned you to my side so that you might understand our intentions.
zh: 我召你们前来，是为了让你们明白我们的意图。

en: While battling Kanon， you must have sensed the wicked forces at work; he was relegated to the darkness for a reason.
zh: 与卡农作战时，你们想必已经感受到了邪恶的力量。他被放逐黑暗，自有其缘由。

en: But now we face a larger threat: an Earthblood who hides among your royalty.
zh: 但现在，有个更大的威胁：一个地界人，正藏在你们的王族之中。

en: She has tricked Kanon into sheltering her in the castle.
zh: 她骗取了卡农的信任，藏身城堡。

en: To keep humanity safe， you must slay this impostor and all who answer to her.
zh: 为了人类的安危，你们必须杀死这个冒牌货，以及所有听命于她的人。

en: May the Skyborn count on you?
zh: 天界人可以信赖你们吗？

en: A fine answer. I will speed you on to the castle. Go， and purge your world of evil!
zh: 答得好。我会立刻送你们去城堡。去吧，将邪恶逐出你们的世界！

en: As you wish.
zh: 如你们所愿。

en: Then I shall return you to the castle.
zh: 那我就送你们回城堡。

en: You question us? Unwise.
zh: 你们竟敢质疑我们？不明智。

en: Take a moment to reflect upon the error of your ways.
zh: 好好反省你们的错误吧。

en: We acknowledge your strength.
zh: 我们认可你们的力量。

en: Now， show us you have wisdom. The Earthblood seek to break this world's delicate balance!
zh: 现在，向我们证明你们也有智慧。地界人妄图打破这个世界脆弱的平衡！

en: You have the power to intervene.
zh: 你们有能力阻止他们。

en: What is your answer?
zh: 你们如何回答？

en: Will you slay the Earthblood's pawns， starting with this man?
zh: 你们愿意从这个人开始，杀死地界人的爪牙吗？

en: Correct.
zh: 正确。

en: However， this man has been cleansed of evil. The question was a test.
zh: 不过，此人已被净化，除去了邪念。刚才的问题只是考验。

en: He is your adversary no more.
zh: 他已不再是你们的敌人。

en: The Valgar whose life you must take is that of this boy's father， King Valgar-- the Earthblood impostor.
zh: 你们必须杀死的瓦尔加，是这少年的父亲，瓦尔加国王……那个地界人冒牌货。

en: That is your right.
zh: 这是你们的权利。

en: Then go now， and end this conflict as ordinary warriors.
zh: 那就去吧，以凡人战士的身份，结束这场纷争。

en: A foolish reply. It has cost you a powerful ally!
zh: 愚蠢的回答。你们因此失去了一位强大的盟友！

en: Leave our sacred realm!
zh: 离开我们的圣域！

en: I have made many mistakes. I know that now.
zh: 我犯下了太多错误。如今，我终于明白了。

en: I thought the blood in my veins was justification enough for all my actions.
zh: 我以为自己身上的血统，足以成为一切行为的理由。

en: Instead of serving my subjects， I sought only to serve myself. Words cannot express my shame.
zh: 我只知满足私欲，不曾为臣民着想。这份羞愧，言语无法表达。

en: But I vow to change that! From this day forward， my life belongs to my people. I will defend them at any cost!
zh: 但我发誓要改变！从今往后，我的生命属于百姓。我会不惜一切保护他们！

en: So， you man-creatures have refused the Skyborn's help， but wish the Earthblood harm?
zh: 这么说，你们这些人类拒绝了天界人的帮助，却还想与地界人为敌？

en: Foolish. But， as you wish.
zh: 愚蠢。不过，如你们所愿。

en: I look forward to seeing if your kind has learned anything during my long slumber.
zh: 我倒想看看，在我漫长的沉睡中，你们这一族究竟长进了多少。

en: Is that true!? The king is a demon doppelganger?
zh: 是真的吗！？国王是恶魔冒充的？

en: What!? You mean the king is some kind of demon?
zh: 什么！？你是说，国王是某种恶魔？

en: No way! The king's not human!?
zh: 不会吧！国王不是人类！？

en: Our kingdom， ruled by another race? Could it be true?
zh: 我们的王国，竟由异族统治？这是真的吗？

en: Wow. Guess they'll put a
zh: 哇，看来现在随便什么家伙，

en: crown on just about anybody.
zh: 都能戴王冠了。

en: Fortune smiles upon us! Let's smash these doors down and put an end to the tyrants!
zh: 天助我等！砸开这几扇门，终结暴君的统治吧！

en: Evil still lurks in the castle.
zh: 城堡里仍潜伏着邪恶。

en: But we'll soon fix that. You liberate the town!
zh: 不过很快就能解决。你们去解放城镇！

en: Wait! Bad idea.
zh: 等等！这样不行。

en: The king will be guarded by a host of magical creatures. The castle should be our job. You take care of the town!
zh: 国王身边一定守着大批魔物。城堡交给我们，你们去照顾镇上！

en: Not so fast! Kanon will have trained other mages. It's not safe.
zh: 别急！卡农一定训练了别的法师，那里不安全。

en: Take care of the townspeople. We'll storm the castle.
zh: 照顾好镇民。城堡由我们来攻。

en: Don't be fools! You underestimate the royal family's dark powers.
zh: 别犯傻！你们低估了王室的黑暗力量。

en: Stay here. Liberating the castle must fall to us.
zh: 留在这里。解放城堡的重任，必须由我们承担。

en: Actually， we were going for “covert.“ Green stands out.
zh: 其实我们打算偷偷潜入。绿色太显眼了。

en: But why don't you babysi-- I mean PROTECT the townsfolk?
zh: 不如你们去照看……我是说，保护镇民吧？

en: Ye who despise the powers of evil， I commend you.
zh: 憎恶邪恶力量之人啊，我赞赏你们。

en: One day， you shall serve us as a powerful force. The Earthblood hide within the castle walls. Go now-- and end them!
zh: 终有一天，你们将成为我们的强大战力。地界人藏在城堡内。去吧……消灭他们！

en: If you wish to protect the people， you must exterminate the false monarchy.
zh: 想保护百姓，就必须铲除虚假的王室。

en: Come to me， warriors. I will help you see this task through.
zh: 战士们，到我这里来。我会助你们完成此事。

en: Father! Is it true?
zh: 父王！这是真的吗？

en: Kanon said we are not of royal blood! That we are just pawns in his schemes to bend  the world to the way of magic!
zh: 卡农说，我们并非王族血脉！我们只是他用来让世界臣服魔法的棋子！

en: So what if we are? Let Kanon have his way with the kingdom. It's no concern of ours.
zh: 是又如何？让卡农随意摆布王国就是，与我们何干。

en: Did those words truly just issue from the mouth of THE KING?
zh: 这话，当真出自一国之君的口中？

en: I'll end your reign right here!
zh: 我要在此终结你的统治！

en: Oh yes， Valgar. Threaten him now， AFTER he's brought the land to ruin. Very noble.
zh: 哦，真好，瓦尔加。非等他把国土糟蹋完了，你才来威胁他。真高尚啊。

en: Need some counseling， guys?
zh: 各位，要不要做个心理咨询？

en: Step into my office.
zh: 请进我的诊室。

en: Couldn't you have had this conversation a few chapters ago? Really.
zh: 这话你们就不能早几章再谈吗？真是的。

en: A family squabble?
zh: 家庭争执？

en: How heartbreaking.
zh: 真令人心碎。

en: Oh， they're having some warm-and-fuzzy time! That's so sweet!
zh: 哦，他们一家正在温馨谈心呢！真甜蜜！

en: Hmph. You again? Stay out of this!
zh: 哼，又是你们？少管闲事！

en: You shameless puppet!
zh: 无耻的傀儡！

en: Our land is in shambles. Don't you care?
zh: 国土已满目疮痍，你就毫不在乎？

en: If you don't care about your people， then it's time you vacated the throne.
zh: 既然不关心百姓，就该从王座上滚下来了。

en: I'm with Valgar. This king's a royal donkey.
zh: 我站瓦尔加这边。这国王就是头戴王冠的蠢驴。

en: I am appalled. You have no claim to a kingdom you do not love!
zh: 真令我愤慨。不爱这个王国，你就不配统治它！

en: You're a terrible king! I bet you didn't even read my letters!
zh: 你是个烂国王！肯定连我写的信都没读！

en: Ha ha ha ha! Why should the Earthblood care what befalls the human realm?
zh: 哈哈哈哈！人类的国度变成什么样，与地界人何干？

en: You creatures are stepping stones to a higher purpose.
zh: 你们这些生物，不过是通往更高目标的垫脚石。

en: Farewell， fools. The time to shed this hideous disguise has drawn near.
zh: 再见，蠢货们。脱下这身丑陋伪装的时刻，快到了。

en: Warriors capable of ending the Earthblood! At last...
zh: 能消灭地界人的战士！终于……

en: I have been waiting for mortals of your caliber.
zh: 我一直在等你们这样的凡人。

en: Come to my side， brave ones.
zh: 勇者们，到我这里来。

en: Why would you seize the throne， if not for power?
zh: 若不是为了权力，你为什么要夺取王位？

en: You became a king just so Kanon could get all the power?
zh: 你当国王，就是为了把权力全让给卡农？

en: So， you became a king， but you don't care about power?
zh: 所以，你当上了国王，却根本不在乎权力？

en: How， in good conscience， could you cede power to a madman?
zh: 将大权交给疯子，你的良心怎能安宁？

en: Why would you want to be king if you don't make the rules?
zh: 规矩都不能自己定，那你当国王干什么？

en: Ha ha ha! I seek more power than this human realm could ever offer.
zh: 哈哈哈！我追求的力量，远远超出这个人类国度所能给予的。

en: But being king has its advantages; I could keep a  watchful eye on Kanon while we Earthblood gathered strength.
zh: 但当国王自有好处。在我们地界人积蓄力量时，我能牢牢盯住卡农。

en: Soon， our use for this human world will end. Unless， of course， it were to yield capable warriors. Survive this next trial， and you may look upon my true form.
zh: 很快，这个人类世界就不再有用。当然，除非这里能出现称职的战士。熬过下一场考验，你们便能见到我的真身。

en: No， Valgar! Killing the king achieves nothing!
zh: 不，瓦尔加！杀死国王毫无意义！

en: Stop it! Killing the king won't solve anything!
zh: 住手！杀了国王解决不了任何事！

en: Whoa， whoa， time out! What is going on here?
zh: 等等，暂停！到底怎么回事？

en: Easy， lad. Taking your father's life will not undo his mistakes.
zh: 冷静些，年轻人。杀死父亲，也无法挽回他的过错。

en: Hey! Boys!
zh: 喂！男孩子们！

en: Do you need to take a time out?
zh: 要不要先冷静一下？

en: Ha ha ha ha! You and your human sympathy.
zh: 哈哈哈哈！你们人类这可笑的同情心。

en: Instead of worrying about me， worry about Kanon.
zh: 与其替我担心，不如担心卡农。

en: His creations still stand poised to overrun your land.
zh: 他的造物仍蓄势待发，随时会踏平你们的土地。

en: At last， the king is dead! We are free of his wicked tyranny!
zh: 国王终于死了！我们摆脱他的残暴统治了！

en: Ooh， celebrities!
zh: 哦，大英雄来啦！

en: We must sing of your exploits. But first， find the prince! We'll secure the throne.
zh: 我们定要歌颂你们的功绩。不过先去找王子吧！我们守住王座。

en: What!? Father!
zh: 什么！？父王！

en: He just... vanished...
zh: 他竟然……消失了……

en: Huh? What manner of creature...
zh: 嗯？这是什么生物……

en: Great， what the heck is attacking us now!?
zh: 真好，这回又是什么鬼东西在打我们！？

en: Who invited these uglies?
zh: 谁把这些丑八怪叫来的？

en: Hm? These beasts are not from our world.
zh: 嗯？这些野兽不属于我们的世界。

en: Ugh! Giant lizards!
zh: 呕！好大的蜥蜴！

en: Birds? Goats? Whatever.
zh: 鸟？山羊？管它呢。

en: Father... is possessed? No， I refuse to accept it!
zh: 父王……被附身了？不，我不相信！

en: The mechs! They're still operative!?
zh: 机甲！它们还能动！？

en: At last! Warriors who can stand against the Earthblood!
zh: 终于！能与地界人抗衡的战士！

en: Perhaps you can rid this world of its true evils.
zh: 或许，你们能铲除这个世界真正的邪恶。

en: Annngh!
zh: 呃啊！

en: You intractable pests! I refuse to play games with you any longer!
zh: 你们这帮顽固的害虫！我不想再陪你们玩了！

en: My thoughts exactly!
zh: 正合我意！

en: Fools. What did that solve?
zh: 蠢货。这又解决了什么？

en: Not even death... will quell this rage...
zh: 纵然一死……也无法平息这怒火……

en: It grieves me to say this... but you were right. I believed in Kanon--that he would revive our kingdom， keep our people safe with his mechs and golems.
zh: 我很不愿承认……但你们说得对。我曾深信卡农，认为他能复兴王国，用机甲与魔像守护百姓。

en: I thought I would be the cornerstone of our future.
zh: 我以为自己将成为未来的基石。

en: Not some smoothed pebble on his game board...
zh: 谁知，只是他棋盘上一颗磨圆的小石子……

en: What have I done?
zh: 我究竟做了什么？

en: Our kingdom can be rebuilt， but not with regret or sorrow. Join us， Valgar. If you fight as fiercely for good as you did for evil， we've hope yet.
zh: 王国可以重建，但靠懊悔和悲伤不行。加入我们吧，瓦尔加。若你能像昔日作恶时一样，奋勇为善，我们就还有希望。

en: The Skyborn and Earthblood?
zh: 天界人和地界人？

en: You intend to face them!?
zh: 你们要挑战他们！？

en: Kanon's mechs. Yes， we must stop them!
zh: 卡农的机甲。没错，必须阻止它们！

en: I know of a tunnel further in. Kanon had it sealed off， but perhaps now... Come with me.
zh: 我知道里面有条隧道。卡农把它封死了，但现在或许……跟我来。

en: You've just talked a lot， that's what. How about a little action?
zh: 你光顾着说了一大堆。是不是该行动了？

en: News flash， Pebble--
zh: 小石子，告诉你个新消息——

en: The world isn't safe yet! Pull it together!
zh: 世界还没安全呢！振作起来！

en: Save your regrets.
zh: 收起你的悔恨。

en: A lion with a singed tail must wear his mane more proudly!
zh: 尾巴烧焦的狮子，更该昂首挺起鬃毛！

en: Aw， save it. You've got the whole rest of your life to feel bad!
zh: 唉，省省吧。往后的日子，还够你难受一辈子！

en: Right now， you need to focus on not screwing up worse.
zh: 眼下，你得先想想怎么别再把事情搞砸。

en: What!? They've caught me? Impossible! My power exceeds theirs!
zh: 什么！？他们抓到我了？不可能！我的力量明明比他们强！

en: And mine yours.
zh: 而我的力量，比你更强。

en: King Valgar? But... how the devil did you get here?
zh: 瓦尔加国王？可是……你到底怎么到这里来的？

en: Fool. You style yourself “Conqueror of the Earthblood.“ But no human conquers US.
zh: 蠢货。你自称“地界人的征服者”。可没有人类能征服我们。

en: Did you think we'd forgotten that you helped the Skyborn banish us to darkness? Die， you pathetic pawn.
zh: 你以为我们忘了吗，是你帮天界人将我们放逐黑暗！去死吧，可悲的棋子。

en: I learned a thing or two from Kanon about replacing kings.
zh: 从卡农那里，我也学了几手替换国王的把戏。

en: And now that our power has sufficiently returned， WE shall tear the Skyborn from the heavens! That vengeance was never his right!
zh: 如今，我们的力量已恢复得足够多。该由我们把天界人从天上拖下来！这复仇之权，从来不属于他！

en: Be comforted， humans. You stand before the ruler of the Earthblood， the greatest of all races.
zh: 安心吧，人类。站在你们面前的，是最强种族地界人的统治者。

en: I have observed many battles over the eons， but you fight unlike any other man-creatures. You possess... exceptional traits. Therefore， I wish to share a secret with you.
zh: 漫长岁月中，我见过无数战斗，但你们的战斗方式与其他人类全然不同。你们拥有……非凡的特质。所以，我愿与你们分享一个秘密。

en: Your race and mine began the same.
zh: 你我两族，原本同出一源。

en: Kanon has only told you half of what you need to know. But listen， and I can give you the absolute truth. I can reveal this world's true evil.
zh: 卡农只告诉了你们一半的真相。但听我说，我能告诉你们完整的事实，揭露这个世界真正的邪恶。

en: Humans! Always making it about race. But ignoring the truth will not exempt you from it.
zh: 人类！总把一切归结于种族差异。但无视真相，并不能让你们置身事外。

en: So that is your only concern?
zh: 所以，你们只关心这个？

en: Your tiny slice of the world? Then go. Seek your own purpose.
zh: 只关心自己那一小片天地？那就走吧，寻找你们自己的目标。

en: A brave answer.
zh: 勇敢的回答。

en: Ahead you shall be pitted against my Earthblood kin. Should you defeat them， I will accept you as worthy warriors.
zh: 前方，我的地界人同胞将与你们交手。若能战胜他们，我就承认你们是合格的战士。

en: This cannot be... The king， a demon!?
zh: 不可能……国王竟是恶魔！？

en: A demon wearing the crown? What next?
zh: 恶魔戴王冠？接下来还会怎样？

en: First the king's a fraud， and now he's a DEMON fraud? I give up.
zh: 先说国王是假的，现在又说他是个假扮国王的恶魔？我服了。

en: A demon king! Where do the deceptions end?
zh: 恶魔国王！这些骗局何时才能结束？

en: This is mind-blowing!
zh: 太惊人了！

en: The king is a chick! (I think?)
zh: 国王居然是个女的！（好像是？）

en: Hmph. Enter the self-styled “royal entourage.“
zh: 哼，自称“王室随从”的家伙们也登场了。

en: How long did it take you and Kanon to concoct that absurd fairy tale?
zh: 你跟卡农编这荒唐故事，花了多久？

en: You and he are alike: the only royal blood in your veins is that which you have leeched away from my family in your quest for power!
zh: 你跟他一样！你们体内唯一的王族之血，就是你们为夺权，从我家人身上吸走的血！

en: Ha ha ha! Can not even the land's finest knight--the king's own SON--see the facts that lie so plain beneath the surface?
zh: 哈哈哈！竟连王国最优秀的骑士，国王亲生的儿子，都看不清这表象之下再明显不过的事实？

en: There is no one in this kingdom you can trust-- not even me.
zh: 这个王国里，没有任何人值得你信任……包括我。

en: Kanon spoke truly， I'm afraid. He manipulated me and my kin， intending to use our power and wage war upon the Skyborn.
zh: 恐怕卡农说的是真的。他操纵我和我的族人，妄图利用我们的力量向天界人开战。

en: But that vengeance was never his right! It is ours， the Earthblood's destiny to tear those tyrants from the heavens!
zh: 但这复仇之权从来不属于他！将那些暴君从天上拖下来，是我们地界人的宿命！

en: You monster! What have you done with my father!?
zh: 你这怪物！你把我的父王怎么样了！？

en: All of these lies must stop! I am the true prince， and this throne is mine to defend!
zh: 这些谎言该结束了！我是真正的王子，我要守住这个王位！

en: Oh， shut up， you weevil.
zh: 哦，闭嘴吧，小虫子。

en: Take the throne; the affairs of this world are beneath us.
zh: 王位拿去便是。这个世界的俗务，不值得我们过问。

en: Just as our affairs are no concern of yours.
zh: 同样，我们的事也轮不到你来管。

en: And so the truth is laid bare.
zh: 如今，真相已彻底揭晓。

en: Your kingdom has been dancing at the end of that Earthblood monster's strings.
zh: 你们的王国，一直被那个地界人怪物牵线操纵。

en: Time grows short. The Earthblood will conquer your lands on their way to the skies.
zh: 时间不多了。地界人通往天空之路，将踏平你们的土地。

en: Rise up now， ye warriors-- and protect your human world!
zh: 战士们，奋起吧……保护你们人类的世界！

en: Valgar! BABE! Help is on the way!
zh: 瓦尔加！宝贝！救兵来了！

en: Do I know how to make an entrance or what? Forget Nick! “Right in the Zur of time!“ That's what they oughta say!
zh: 我这登场够精彩吧？什么“千钧一发”！以后得说“祖尔一到，危机全消”！

en: You anarchists are persistent.
zh: 你们这些乱党，真是阴魂不散。

en: I refuse to believe Kanon's lies about the throne.
zh: 我绝不相信卡农关于王位的谎言。

en: But even if they are true， and the Earthblood or whatever they're called are where we get our power--so what?
zh: 可就算是真的，什么地界人也好，别的什么也罢，我们的力量来自他们，那又如何？

en: I will seize the throne from my weakling father and bring the demons in line!
zh: 我要从软弱的父王手中夺取王位，再让那些恶魔乖乖听命！

en: Ha ha ha! Stupid boy. He hasn't the slightest idea who has been controlling whom.
zh: 哈哈哈！愚蠢的小子。他根本不知道，到底是谁在操纵谁。

en: I'd like to see you try!
zh: 我倒要看看，你有什么本事！

en: Foolish man-creature.
zh: 愚蠢的人类。

en: Do you really think we Earthblood would bow down to one as weak as you?
zh: 你真以为，我们地界人会向你这样的弱者低头？

en: We no longer need you humans to shelter us while we nurse ourselves back to full strength. We are ready to destroy the Skyborn now!
zh: 我们已不再需要人类庇护，来慢慢恢复力量。现在，我们已能消灭天界人了！

en: What!? Kanon's familiars...
zh: 什么！？卡农的使魔……

en: They were Earthblood!? I have been deceived!
zh: 竟是地界人！？我被骗了！

en: Impossible! A demon was posing as the king!?
zh: 不可能！竟是恶魔假扮国王！？

en: What!? The king's a demon!
zh: 什么！？国王是恶魔！

en: Um， did the king just turn into a demon?
zh: 呃，国王刚刚是不是变成恶魔了？

en: What!? The king was a demon in disguise all along?
zh: 什么！？国王一直都是恶魔假扮的？

en: Whoa! I guess they'll give a crown to anybody these days.
zh: 哇！如今真是什么家伙都能戴王冠了。

en: Know your place， humans.
zh: 认清自己的身份，人类。

en: There is no room for your kind in this eternal struggle between Earthblood and Skyborn.
zh: 地界人与天界人这场永恒的争斗，没有你们插手的余地。

en: If you try to interfere， I will not hesitate to wipe you from existence!
zh: 胆敢干涉，我就毫不犹豫地将你们彻底抹杀！

en: So these are the Earthblood.
zh: 原来，这就是地界人。

en: So these are Earthblood.
zh: 原来，这些就是地界人。

en: Gross! These are Earthblood?
zh: 好恶心！这就是地界人？

en: So， these grotesque monsters are the Earthblood's true form.
zh: 原来，这些丑陋怪物才是地界人的真面目。

en: Eww， nasty! They smell like dirty!
zh: 呕，恶心！一股脏兮兮的味道！

en: I summoned you to my side so that you might understand our intentions. Listen well to what I have to say.
zh: 我召你们前来，是为了让你们明白我们的意图。仔细听好。

en: If you wish you save your world， you need to open your eyes to a greater threat.
zh: 想拯救你们的世界，就必须认清更大的威胁。

en: One of the Earthblood hides among your human royalty.
zh: 有一个地界人，藏在你们人类的王族之中。

en: She has tricked Kanon into sheltering her in the castle， and intends to plunge the world into darkness.
zh: 她骗取卡农的信任，藏身城堡，妄图将世界拖入黑暗。

en: You must decide: will you destroy all pawns of the Earthblood， starting with this man?
zh: 做出选择吧：你们愿意从这个人开始，消灭地界人的所有爪牙吗？

en: However， we have already purged this man's heart of evil.
zh: 不过，我们已经清除了此人心中的邪恶。

en: The prince is no longer the adversary you need fear.
zh: 王子已不再是你们需要畏惧的敌人。

en: The danger is King Valgar， who is really the Earthblood ruler.
zh: 真正的威胁，是瓦尔加国王。他其实就是地界人的统治者。

en: Ah. A bold reply， or a desperate attempt to escape?
zh: 啊，勇敢的回答。还是说，只是想趁机逃走？

en: Very well， so be it. We will release you and this man. Go， fight your petty battle.
zh: 好吧，就这样。我们放你们和此人离开。去打你们那微不足道的仗吧。

en: A foolish reply. It has cost you a powerful ally. May you wander forever in your human halls of ignorance!
zh: 愚蠢的回答。你们因此失去了一位强大的盟友。愿你们永远迷失在人类的无知之中！

en: I realize now I have been fighting for the wrong cause.
zh: 我终于明白，我一直都站错了立场。

en: What I have seen here all but proves Kanon spoke the truth.
zh: 在这里的所见所闻，几乎已证实卡农所言不虚。

en: I know apologies come cheap...
zh: 我知道，道歉轻而易举……

en: But I am sorry. From this day forward， I promise my life belongs to my people. I will defend them at any cost!
zh: 但我确实深感抱歉。从今往后，我发誓，我的生命属于百姓。我会不惜一切保护他们！

en: That cannot be! The king is a demon doppelganger?
zh: 不可能！国王是恶魔冒充的？

en: You're kidding!? The king's not human?
zh: 开什么玩笑！？国王不是人类？

en: Is that true!? Our kingdom is secretly under demon rule?
zh: 是真的吗！？我们的王国，一直被恶魔暗中统治？

en: The king's a demon!? Whoa!
zh: 国王是恶魔！？天哪！

en: I ask again: listen to what I have to say. I can reveal the true nature of this world.
zh: 我再说一次：听我说完。我能揭示这个世界的真正面目。

en: I have observed many battles over the eons， but you possess qualities unlike any other man-creatures I have seen.
zh: 漫长岁月中，我见过无数战斗，但你们拥有我从未在其他人类身上见过的特质。

en: Therefore， I wish to share a secret with you: your race and mine began the same.
zh: 所以，我愿与你们分享一个秘密：你我两族，原本同出一源。

en: Then I am afraid you and I must sever our ties. Permanently!
zh: 那么恐怕，你我的关系只能就此斩断。彻底斩断！
